confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Beijing price levels, not checked against live menus, booking pages, or listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are the more reliable; July hotel rates vary with summer demand and carry wider uncertainty. Cocktail and wine anchors rest on weaker direct knowledge and were set at typical Beijing bar and restaurant markups over the beer anchor. The FX value is the RBA published observation; the price anchors do not come from web sources.
comparable_city_reasoning: East Asia basis: benchmarked against other large mainland Chinese tier-1 cities, chiefly Shanghai, for restaurant and hotel price levels; no single city was copied directly.
